summary: Mobile View – Invoice Layout Under Finance Tab Not Displaying Correctly
reported_issue: When viewing an invoice under the Finance tab in mobile view, the invoice layout does not render properly — elements appear misaligned, clipped, or out of order, making the invoice difficult or impossible to read on mobile.
expected_after_fix: The invoice under the Finance tab should render correctly and be readable in mobile/responsive view.
steps_i_followed: Booted SPA in a mobile viewport (390x844, isMobile+touch, iPhone Safari UA).
Opened a paid WO (S9-24674) => Finance tab, which renders the invoice preview.
Measured document width vs viewport to detect horizontal clipping/overflow.
Captured a full-page mobile screenshot and visually inspected element order, alignment, and readability.
actual_now: The invoice renders correctly and is fully readable on the mobile viewport. There is no horizontal overflow/clipping (documentElement scrollWidth 390 == viewport 390, overflowX 0) and no error. Content is in the correct order: shop header, Invoice number/date, Bill To, Remit payment to, vehicle info table, Service Order/Terms table, line-items table (Description/Quantity/Rate/Amount with Labor and Parts rows incl. the caps part description), Parts/Labor/Line totals, the totals block (Labor, Parts, Shop supplies, Subtotal, GST, Total, Payments, Balance), warranty terms, customer signature/printed name/date, and GST#/Powered by ShopView footer. The only residual is a minor cosmetic overlap of the shop logo image with the 'Invoice: INV-S9-24674' title/date in the header; it does not make the invoice difficult or impossible to read.
notes: Tested via responsive/mobile viewport emulation (matches reported mobile/responsive view). The reported severe symptoms (misaligned, clipped, out of order, impossible to read) do not reproduce — the invoice is a well-ordered, fully readable responsive layout with no horizontal clipping. Minor caveat: a small header overlap between the shop logo graphic and the invoice-number block remains (cosmetic). Confidence medium due to the subjective/visual nature of layout assessment.
